downloadEvidence: Six earlier downloads plus 69 new normal authenticated downloads under observed existing agreement access. Each detail page was checked immediately before DOWNLOAD for exact Creative ID, Royalty-free and no editorial-only notice. No purchase, visible credit charge or new-terms action was taken. New assets 1321502100, 183319682 and 894870474 used Medium, their highest offered size; the other 66 new assets used Large. Earlier asset 1315418850 also used Medium.
licenseCaveat: Existing agreement availability and successful downloads were observed; confidential agreement terms were not exported or independently reviewed. Royalty-free is not public domain or unrestricted redistribution. Original full-resolution files remain outside this public repository.
processing: Web JPEG derivatives: high-quality bicubic, quality 85, preserved aspect ratio. Earlier six are 1600px wide; 69 new assets have a maximum edge of 1600px. Source dimensions, byte lengths and SHA256 hashes independently read from downloaded original files; originals remain outside Git. Contributor credits retained separately.
